pages.lesson:
LESSON: KUSOMA 10.2.1 KUSOMA KWA KINA TAMTHILIA WAHUSIKA

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: KUKABILIANA NA HISIA Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli za U
Topic 10.2: Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia Wahusika

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia Wahusika. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua wahusika katika tamthilia aliyosoma
2. kujadili sifa za wahusika katika tamthilia
3. kujadili mafunzo yanayotokana na wahusika katika tamthilia

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua wahusika katika tamthilia aliyosoma
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua wahusika katika tamthilia aliyosoma. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kujadili sifa za wahusika katika tamthilia
   In simple words: practise until you can kujadili sifa za wahusika katika tamthilia. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kujadili mafunzo yanayotokana na wahusika katika tamthilia
   In simple words: practise until you can kujadili mafunzo yanayotokana na wahusika katika tamthilia. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia Wahusika using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia Wahusika in the examples.
2. Explain Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia Wahusika to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia Wahusika.
4. Show that you can: kutambua wahusika katika tamthilia aliyosoma

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia Wahusika using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Tamthilia Wahusika important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua wahusika katika tamthilia aliyosoma
2. kujadili sifa za wahusika katika tamthilia
3. kujadili mafunzo yanayotokana na wahusika katika tamthilia

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
